verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own Merge Readiness panel lists a 'Tests status' and a 'Compile/typecheck step', so it surfaces test and build validation for agent-built changes. Nothing shows the agent writing new tests or iterating on failures before it proposes the change, and the evidence is a single thin UI listing. GitHub Actions support is host-platform CI and earns no credit. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent generates tests, documentation that the agent runs tests itself as a pre-proposal self-validation loop, details of how test results feed back into the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
